ingredients.name: unsweetened evaporated milk or coconut milk

steps.instruction: Add 3 pounds of peeled, grated raw cassava to a large bowl.
Add 1/2 teaspoon each of ground cinnamon, black pepper and ground nutmeg.
Add 2 teaspoons of vanilla extract and 4 tablespoons of melted butter or coconut oil.
Add 3/4 cup of brown sugar and 3 cups of evaporated milk or coconut milk.
steps.spoken: Add 3/4 cup of brown sugar and 3 cups of unsweetened evaporated milk or coconut milk.

steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Bake for 60 minutes, until firm and golden.
